basis: daily_tr = (P_t + D_t) / (P_{t-1} / s_t) - 1 on Yahoo as-traded Close (never Adj Close), D_t = cash per share going ex on t, s_t = split ratio effective on t; Bloomberg = DAY_TO_DAY_TOT_RETURN_GROSS_DVDS / 100 (percent); differences in basis points; statistics on common trade dates only

bloomberg_union.rule: later partition wins on a duplicate (security, date)

bloomberg_mapping: name N -> security column value 'N US Equity'
